skill.name: clinvar-database
skill.description: Use ClinVar to search genetic variants, review clinical significance, access NCBI E-utilities, download public datasets, and annotate VCF files.
skill.summary: Search ClinVar variant records and interpret clinical significance for research workflows.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown examples, public ClinVar endpoints, placeholders, or normal documentation and were judged false positives. Confirmed issues are limited to unsafe FTP transfer patterns and one remote installer command that downloads and executes unauthenticated content.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the pipe-to-shell installer with a reviewed HTTPS download, pinned version, checksum verification, and explicit user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: ClinVar bulk downloads use plain FTP
remediation.suggestion: Prefer HTTPS mirrors when available. If FTP is required, document checksum verification and release provenance before using downloaded files.

remediation.issue: Command examples can be run without safety context
remediation.suggestion: Label bulk download and installer commands as manual examples, add file size warnings, and tell agents not to run them without user approval.

content.value_statement: Variant interpretation requires current, well-documented evidence. This skill guides ClinVar searches, data access, format selection, and cautious clinical significance review.
actual_capabilities: Guides searches by gene, condition, variant name, chromosome, and clinical significance.
Explains ClinVar review status, star ratings, conflicts, and VUS handling.
Documents NCBI E-utilities endpoints for search, summary, fetch, and related links.
Compares XML, VCF, and tab-delimited ClinVar data formats for research workflows.
Provides examples for annotating VCF files and filtering variant summaries.
limitations: It does not provide diagnosis or replace review by a genetics professional.
ClinVar classifications can change as submitters add new evidence.
Bulk files can be large and may require careful storage planning.
VCF files exclude some large, complex, or imprecisely mapped variants.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Disease Variants
use_cases.description: Find high-confidence pathogenic variants for a target gene or condition, then check review status and conflicts.

use_cases.title: Plan Variant Annotation
use_cases.description: Choose ClinVar VCF, XML, or tab-delimited data for a sequencing annotation workflow.

use_cases.title: Review Conflicting Evidence
use_cases.description: Compare submitter interpretations, review dates, and star ratings before summarizing variant evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Find Variants for a Gene
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me search ClinVar for variants in [GENE]. Include useful filters for clinical significance and review status.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret ClinVar Classification
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the ClinVar classification, review status, and conflict risks for [VARIANT OR ACCESSION]. Note what requires expert review.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Data Format
prompt_templates.prompt: I need ClinVar data for [PIPELINE GOAL]. Compare XML, VCF, and tab-delimited formats and recommend a source.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reproducible Annotation Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reproducible ClinVar annotation workflow for [GENOME BUILD] VCF files. Include release tracking, conflict flags, and safety checks.

output_examples.output: Use BRCA1 gene filters with pathogenic significance and expert panel or practice guideline review. Flag conflicts and record the access date.

output_examples.input: Choose a ClinVar format for VCF annotation.
output_examples.output: Use ClinVar VCF for coordinate-based annotation. Use XML when you need full evidence, submissions, and variant-condition details.
Report each classification, review status, submitter count, and update date. Treat unresolved conflicts as requiring manual genetics review.

best_practices: Record the ClinVar release, genome build, and access date for every analysis.
Prefer expert panel or practice guideline records when clinical confidence matters.
Verify downloads and review commands before running bulk data or installer examples.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a VUS as a diagnosis or clinical action recommendation.
Do not mix GRCh37 and GRCh38 coordinates without explicit assembly tracking.
Do not run FTP or installer commands without checking source integrity first.

faq.question: Does this skill make medical decisions?
faq.answer: No. It supports research and data review. Clinical decisions require qualified genetics professionals.

faq.question: Which ClinVar format should I use for annotation?
faq.answer: Use VCF for coordinate-based annotation. Use XML for full submission evidence and tab-delimited files for summaries.

faq.question: Can ClinVar classifications change?
faq.answer: Yes. New evidence, updated criteria, and submitter changes can reclassify variants over time.

faq.question: How should I handle conflicting interpretations?
faq.answer: Check review status, evidence, dates, and submitters. Flag unresolved conflicts for manual expert review.

faq.question: Does the skill require an API key?
faq.answer: No key is required for basic E-utilities access. NCBI API keys can increase permitted request rates.

faq.question: Is this suitable for large bulk downloads?
faq.answer: Yes, but plan storage, rate limits, secure transfer, checksum review, and release version tracking.
